verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists handwriting detection, and its extraction docs describe per-field confidence scores for routing uncertain values to human review. However, handwriting support rests on a single marketing bullet, and nothing shows how handwritten values are extracted or how confidence behaves on them. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of handwritten field extraction, any coverage of annotation recognition, evidence tying confidence scores to handwritten content, and independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, handwritten fields and annotations are recognized and extracted, flagged with confidence when uncertain
